mapper.select: SELECT id, date, title, memo, tag_id, notify_hour, notify_minute, reminder_id FROM todos WHERE date = #{date}
SELECT id, date, title, memo, tag_id, notify_hour, notify_minute, reminder_id FROM todos WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, date, title, memo, tag_id, notify_hour, notify_minute, reminder_id FROM todos WHERE tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (date, title, memo, tag_id, notify_hour, notify_minute, reminder_id) VALUES (#{date}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{tagId}, #{notifyHour}, #{notifyMinute}, #{reminderId})
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET date = #{date}, title = #{title}, memo = #{memo}, tag_id = #{tagId}, notify_hour = #{notifyHour}, notify_minute = #{notifyMinute}, reminder_id = #{reminderId} WHERE id = #{id}
